query: SELECT connection.name, from_location.name AS from_name, to_location.name AS to_name, connection.travel_time, connection.description, connection.gm_notes, connection.storyteller_notes FROM connection JOIN location AS from_location ON from_location.id = connection.from_location_id JOIN location AS to_location ON to_location.id = connection.to_location_id WHERE connection.world_id = ? AND connection.deleted = 0 ORDER BY connection.id
